title: Script GC prototype visitor
summary: Recover the prototype visitor at 0x4f1320 with its ECX/EDX register ABI and direct register-ABI marker dependency.
test_description: Compare original and recovered visitor over signed and zero counts, tag threshold, nullable pointers, white bits, aliasing and all fixture bytes, with FS head restoration. Both call the accepted original marker directly.
known_limits: Marker types outside the dispatch range are tested; its external jump table and recursive type-specific effects are not covered.
Layouts describe 32-bit objects; pointers accessed on active paths must be valid. Marker remains an external dependency. No matching-byte claim is made.
